map.分段按对应档位费率计佣，注意临界点的跳档，大额订单可对比是否触发更高档。结果仅供: Commission is charged per tier at the rate for that band; watch the jump at the thresholds, and for large orders check whether a higher tier is triggered. Results are for e-commerce operations, product selection and decision reference only; they are not financial or tax advice and do not replace each platform latest rules or formal reconciliation, so the platform official rules and actual accounts govern.
